task_metadata.research_topic: protein structure representation learning with geometric GNNs
task_metadata.research_question: Design a novel geometric GNN encoder for learning protein structure representations from 3D alpha-carbon coordinates.
notes: GearNet baseline cites the canonical Zhang et al. 2022 paper (arXiv:2203.06125, ICLR 2023): Protein Representation Learning by Geometric Structure Pretraining.
Test links cover the EC, GO-BP, and fold-classification evaluation lines from the task description.

tests.label: EC
tests.notes: EC number prediction is directly covered by ECPred and also by structure-based protein function prediction in DeepFRI.

tests.label: GO-BP
tests.notes: GO-BP is a multilabel protein function benchmark covered by DeepFRI, DEEPred, NetGO, and LM-GVP.

tests.label: Fold
tests.notes: Fold classification is grounded in protein structure search and fold-recognition literature.

baselines.name: schnet
baselines.notes: Exact paper for the SchNet baseline.

baselines.name: egnn
baselines.notes: Exact paper for the E(n)-equivariant GNN baseline.

baselines.name: gearnet
baselines.notes: Canonical GearNet paper (Zhang et al., ICLR 2023): Protein Representation Learning by Geometric Structure Pretraining.
